messages.subject: How to create legend from WMS layer, and show it in a absolutePanel
parts:
Hi,

I am loading a WMS layer onto my basemap. I am using Leaflet for R to create the map in the first place. I also create an absolutePanel on top of the map object, where I want to house map controls in. In addition to map controls, there should be also the legend shown. Similar to the super-zip example, just that the legend should be inside of the overlaying panel.

Cheers Thomas
